1.f3 f5 2.e4.strategy: Strikes in the centre with a pawn offer, hoping to win time for development against the pawn Black takes. White has to prove the compensation, and the open e1–h4 diagonal stays a liability.

1.f3 f5 2.e4 fxe4.strategy: Takes the offered pawn and pulls White's centre pawn away. Black is a pawn up, and White has little more than open lines to show for it, so Black has only to stay alert to White's quick development.
